name: Road Barricade
desc: Blocks a road at one of its glowing spots: enemies must break it

pad_rule._note: 22 Nov 2026 owner rule. The gate pad (index 2) is near_from_end_m before the firelight. The far pad (index 0) is nearest to WOODS_R - far_in_from_woods_m from camp; a road's far_pad may set its own distance and unlock level. On roads with even_barricade_spacing the middle pad is halfway between those two along the road. Elsewhere it sits at the sharpest bend in bend_window, measured with bend_probe_m, and at least mid_min_gap_from_gate_m along the road from the gate.

_note: Phase G2: not sold in the shop any more. Each road spot (3 per road, placed by pad_rule; slots_at is NO LONGER USED, kept only as a key) takes one row of row.pieces pieces, built by tapping the spot for row.cost. 22 Nov 2026: the pads open ring by ring with the Hearthtree: rings_by_home[Hearthtree level] = how many rings are open, nearest the camp first (ring 1 = the pad nearest the camp on each road, ring 2 = the middle pad, ring 3 = the far pad): levels 1-2 the 4 nearest pads, level 3 adds the 4 middle ones, level 4 adds the two far pads on the right (Fernwood and Bandit Thicket), level 5 opens all 12. Only open pads show their marker; every open empty pad can be built (between waves). A row already built on a pad that is not open yet (an older save) stays, works and can be repaired. rows_by_home is UNUSED now (kept only for old code). Each piece cracks below crack_at of its health and breaks at 0 (it falls, leaving rubble; enemies pass the gap). Repair: repair_share of the row's cost per broken piece, less for cracked ones. levels still set each piece's health and look (upgraded on the Hearthtree's card). slot_gap_min (test floor only, 22 Nov 2026): the closest pair on each road is middle-far; the floor of 2.5 m keeps the two rows apart.
